items.title: SEC Crypto Custody Rewrite Enters White House Review
items.summary: The planned rule would cover advisers and investment companies and clarify digital-asset custody, following the withdrawal of a separate 2023 proposal.

items.title: Brent Tops $106 And Hike Odds Reach 64% As Crypto Sells Off
items.summary: One hundred and three of the 125 largest non-stablecoin tokens were lower on the day after August producer prices came in at 0.4% and the 30-year Treasury yield passed every close of the past five years.

items.title: Strategy's Bitcoin Pile Nears June Record After $76M Purchase
items.summary: The Bitcoin treasury firm’s holdings bottomed at 840,447 BTC in August.
